units.title: 借书袋上的卡片

materials.title: Library Bags 040A
materials.text: At the library, use a cloth bag for your books. Put your library card on the desk. Ask the helper to scan the books. Carry the bag with both hands if it is heavy. Return the books next Tuesday.

questions.prompt: You are ready to borrow books. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B交借书卡；A藏卡妨碍借阅；C午餐无关。

questions.prompt: You need a bag for the books. Ask: ____
options: May I use a cloth bag?
May I put them in water?
questions.explanation: B请求布袋；A玩具、C水均不合装书用途。

questions.prompt: The books need scanning. Say: ____
options: Could you scan these books, please?
questions.explanation: A请助手扫描；B吃书不合用途；C数鞋不完成借阅。

questions.prompt: Your bag is heavy. Say: ____
options: I will pull it with one finger.
I will leave it in the road.
I will carry it with both hands.
questions.explanation: C按重袋要求双手提；A单指、B路上遗留不合要求。

questions.prompt: When should you return the books? Say: ____
questions.explanation: A下周二；B每小时、C上周二不符未来归还时间。

units.title: 画画桌上的清水与脏水

materials.title: Paint Water 040B
materials.text: The art table has two pots. Clean water is in the blue pot. Use the grey pot to wash brushes. Wipe your brush on the cloth before a new colour. Put finished paintings on the drying shelf. Ask for help if paint spills.

questions.prompt: Your brush is dirty. Say: ____
options: I will wash it in the grey pot.
I will wash it in the blue pot.
I will wipe it on a painting.
questions.explanation: A灰罐洗笔；B蓝罐清水不是洗笔罐；C画作不作擦布。

questions.prompt: You want a new colour. Say: ____
options: I will put the cloth away first.
I will wipe my brush on the cloth first.
questions.explanation: C先擦笔；A收布、B泼水不合步骤。

questions.prompt: Your painting is finished. Ask: ____
options: May I put it in the grey pot?
May I put it on the drying shelf?
May I paint on the cloth?
questions.explanation: B晾画架；A水罐、C擦布均非完成画作去处。

questions.prompt: Some paint spills. Say: ____
options: I will cover it with a book.
I will wash my shoes in the blue pot.
questions.explanation: A请求帮助；B盖书、C洗鞋均不处理洒颜料。

questions.prompt: A friend asks which pot has clean water. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B蓝罐有清水；A灰罐、C都脏水均错。

units.title: 窗边的纸链分工

materials.title: Paper Chain 040C
materials.text: Jill and Ben make a paper chain. Jill cuts six red strips. Ben cuts four yellow strips. They join the strips with glue, not tape. The chain is too short for the door. They hang it by the window. They keep the extra paper in a box.

questions.prompt: Jill cuts six red strips.
questions.explanation: A True对应人物数量颜色；B False否定原句。

questions.prompt: Ben cuts six yellow strips.
questions.explanation: B False，黄色四条；A True混用红条数量。

questions.prompt: They use tape to join the strips.
questions.explanation: B False，明确用胶水不用胶带；A True颠倒工具。

questions.prompt: They hang the chain by the window.
questions.explanation: A True与窗边一致；B False否定位置。

questions.prompt: They throw away the extra paper.
questions.explanation: B False，剩纸留盒里；A True与keep冲突。

units.title: 游泳包和集合的问答

materials.title: Swim Bag Replies 040D
materials.text: Before a swimming lesson, choose the reply that answers each question.

questions.prompt: Whose towel is this?
questions.explanation: B回答归属；A触感、C颜色不答whose。

questions.prompt: What is in your bag?
questions.explanation: A回答内容；B位置、C重量不答what is in。

questions.prompt: Where shall we meet?
questions.explanation: C集合地点；A时间、B同行人不是where。

questions.prompt: When does the lesson start?
questions.explanation: A时间；B地点、C开场活动不答when。

questions.prompt: Can you help me close my bag?
questions.explanation: B回应求助；A水温、C泳帽颜色不回应。

units.title: 三层植物架的摆放规则

materials.title: Plant Shelf 040E
materials.text: The science room has a plant shelf with three levels. Cactus pots go on the top level near the sunny window. Young bean plants go on the middle level. Empty pots go on the bottom level. Labels must face the room so pupils can read them. On Fridays, the class turns the bean pots a little to help the plants grow straight.

questions.prompt: Which pots go at the top?
questions.explanation: C仙人掌顶层；A空盆底层；B豆苗中层。

questions.prompt: Why must labels face the room?
questions.explanation: A便于阅读；B重量、C关窗与标签朝向无因果。

questions.prompt: Where are the young bean plants?
questions.explanation: B中层；A底层为空盆；C室外未按架上规定。

questions.prompt: What does the class do on Fridays?
options: It turns the bean pots a little.
questions.explanation: C周五转豆盆；A去标签、B扔豆苗均非动作。

questions.prompt: Why are the bean pots turned?
questions.explanation: B原文明示助直立生长；A遮藏、C填空盆非目的。

units.title: 校车代币的发放

materials.title: Bus Token 040F
materials.text: On the museum trip, pupils use paper tokens for the school bus. Mr Fox gives each pupil two tokens: one for going and one for coming back. Keep the return token in your pocket. The driver collects a token as you get on. If you lose one, tell Mr Fox before boarding. The tokens cannot be used on city buses.

questions.prompt: Each pupil receives two tokens.
questions.explanation: A True对应两枚；B False否定数量。

questions.prompt: The driver collects a token after pupils leave the bus.
questions.explanation: B False，上车as get on时收，不是离车后；A True颠倒时机。

questions.prompt: Pupils should keep the return token in a pocket.
questions.explanation: A True与口袋保管一致；B False否定要求。

questions.prompt: A pupil who loses a token should tell Mr Fox before boarding.
questions.explanation: A True对应丢失处理；B False否定求助时机。

questions.prompt: The tokens work on city buses too.
questions.explanation: B False，明确cannot；A True扩大适用范围。

units.title: 修玩具时找到正确零件

materials.title: Spare Part Box 040G
materials.text: At a repair afternoon, pupils brought broken toy vehicles. The helpers had a box of spare wheels, but the wheels were mixed together. Finding a match took longer than fitting it. Ravi suggested sorting them only by colour. Mei pointed out that two black wheels could still be different sizes. The team sorted by size first and put a small drawing of each wheel shape on the boxes. Colour was written on a label inside each box. After that, helpers found suitable wheels more quickly.

questions.prompt: Which part of the work was slow at first?
questions.explanation: B找匹配轮子比装更慢；A安装是比较中较快项；C画车并非初始工作。

questions.prompt: What weakness did Mei see in sorting only by colour?
options: Same-coloured wheels could differ in size.
questions.explanation: C同色尺寸可不同；A全红与黑轮例子冲突；B不能命名无依据。

questions.prompt: What was the first sorting rule finally used?
questions.explanation: A按尺寸先分；B姓名、C价格非最终标准。

questions.prompt: Where could helpers find colour information?
options: On a label inside each box.
questions.explanation: B盒内标签记颜色；A墙、C衣服均非信息位置。

questions.prompt: What improved after sorting?
questions.explanation: A找轮速度改善；B不再需轮、C停止修理违背效果。

units.title: 室外阅读活动的天气规则

materials.title: Outdoor Reading Cards 040H
materials.text: Outdoor reading is planned for Thursday at 1:30 in the courtyard. Bring a book and a cushion. School chairs will stay indoors. If the ground is wet but there is no rain, the group will use the covered path. If it is raining at 1:00, the activity will move to the library. The location will be written on the classroom door at 1:10.

questions.prompt: The activity is planned for Thursday afternoon.
questions.explanation: A True，周四13:30是下午；B False否定安排。

questions.prompt: Pupils must carry school chairs outside.
questions.explanation: B False，椅子留室内，带坐垫；A True与规定相反。

questions.prompt: Wet ground without rain means using the covered path.
questions.explanation: A True完整符合第一条件；B False否定对应地点。

questions.prompt: Rain at one o’clock means the activity is cancelled.
questions.explanation: B False，下雨改图书馆，不取消；A True混淆搬场与取消。

questions.prompt: The final location will be posted at 1:10.
questions.explanation: A True对应门上公布时间；B False否定时间。

units.title: 小桥调查的样本选择

materials.title: Bridge Survey Letter 040I
materials.text:
Dear Priya,
Our class is asking villagers about the footbridge. We first interviewed people outside the sports centre on Saturday. Most said they crossed it to reach the playing field. Then we realised that our interview place might affect the answers. On Monday, we also asked people near the clinic and the bus stop. We used the same questions at all three places. We recorded no names, only answers. The new answers showed more reasons for crossing, including work and shopping. We will present the results to the village council next week, but the council will make any decision about repairs.
Yours,
Adam

questions.prompt: The first interviews took place outside the sports centre.
questions.explanation: A True地点明示；B False否定首轮位置。

questions.prompt: The class used different questions at each interview place.
questions.explanation: B False，same questions；A True把地点差异混为题目差异。

questions.prompt: The class recorded every person’s name.
questions.explanation: B False，无姓名只记答案；A True与no names冲突。

questions.prompt: The later interviews revealed additional reasons for using the bridge.
questions.explanation: A True，增加工作购物等原因；B False否定调查结果。

questions.prompt: The class will make the final repair decision.
questions.explanation: B False，村议会决定；A True混淆报告者与决策者。

units.title: 共同报告里的修改与署名

materials.title: Shared Draft Talk 040J
materials.text: Your team is writing a shared report. Some facts are still being checked. Choose a reply that deals with the stated problem.

questions.prompt: A teammate asks to change your paragraph. Reply: ____
options: Please show me the change so we can check that it keeps the meaning.
You may delete everyone’s work without reading it.
questions.explanation: A协作核对修改是否保义；B任意删稿破坏合作；C纸色不回应请求。

questions.prompt: You notice an uncertain date. Say: ____
options: A bright colour will make it correct.
Let us check the source before putting this date in the final report.
questions.explanation: C核来源再定日期；A编造、B靠颜色均不保证事实。

questions.prompt: You want to acknowledge a pupil who made the map. Say: ____
options: We should include her name beside the map.
We should say nobody made it.
questions.explanation: B注明贡献者；A藏图、C否认作者不恰当。

questions.prompt: Two teammates disagree about a sentence. Ask: ____
options: What meaning are we trying to express, and which wording says it more clearly?
Can we stop checking every fact?
questions.explanation: B回到意图与清晰度；A身高无关；C放弃查证不解决措辞。

questions.prompt: You need permission to use a classmate’s photo. Ask: ____
options: Why did you take that bus?
Could you make all our decisions?
May we use your photo in this report and credit you?
questions.explanation: C明确用途与署名求许可；A交通、B包揽决策不答授权。

units.title: 小鼓和铃铛的轮流演奏

materials.title: Music Turns 040K
materials.text: In music class, pass the drum to the child on your left. Play only when Ms Lee points to you. Put bells in the green basket after the song. Keep the drum on the mat. Say sorry if you play at the wrong time.

questions.prompt: Ms Lee points to you. Say: ____
options: It is my turn to play.
questions.explanation: B老师指向自己才轮到演奏；A离开、C吃饭不合信号。

questions.prompt: The song ends. Say: ____
options: I will put the bells in the green basket.
I will put the bells under my shoes.
I will put the bells in the drum.
questions.explanation: A铃回绿篮；B鞋底、C鼓内均非指定位置。

questions.prompt: You play before your turn. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C对误奏道歉；A衣物、B身体数量不回应错误。

questions.prompt: You need to pass the drum. Say: ____
options: I will give it to the child on my left.
I will send it to the door.
I will hold it all day.
questions.explanation: A传给左边同学；B门口、C一直拿着不合轮流。

questions.prompt: You finish using the drum. Say: ____
options: I will hang it on a hook.
I will keep it on the mat.
I will fill it with water.
questions.explanation: B鼓留垫上；A挂钩、C装水不符存放要求。

units.title: 换鞋处的号码夹

materials.title: Shoe Stall 040L
materials.text: At the indoor play room, leave outdoor shoes on the rack. Take a number clip and put it on your shoe pair. Wear clean socks inside. Ask the helper if you cannot find your shoes. Return the clip when you leave.

questions.prompt: You enter the play room. Say: ____
options: I will keep my shoes on the slide.
I will put my shoes in my lunch box.
I will leave my shoes on the rack.
questions.explanation: C室外鞋放架；A滑梯、B饭盒均非鞋存放处。

questions.prompt: You take a number clip. Say: ____
options: I will put it on my shoes.
I will put it in my mouth.
I will put it on someone else’s shoes.
questions.explanation: A夹自己鞋对；B放口中、C夹错鞋均不合标识。

questions.prompt: Your shoes are missing from where you looked. Say: ____
options: Please help me find my shoes.
questions.explanation: B请求助手找鞋；A袜色、C滑梯长度不解决问题。

questions.prompt: You are ready to leave. Say: ____
options: I will return my number clip.
questions.explanation: B离开还号码夹；A全拿、C藏夹违背归还。

questions.prompt: A friend asks what to wear inside. Say: ____
options: A number clip on your head.
questions.explanation: A室内穿干净袜子；B外鞋留架；C头夹号码不答穿着。

units.title: 短尾巴风筝的修改

materials.title: Kite Tail 040M
materials.text: Noah makes a kite from red paper. Its tail is made of blue strips. At first, the tail has two strips. The kite falls on the grass. Noah adds three more strips to the tail. His aunt holds the kite while he picks up the string. They try again in the park, not in the street.

questions.prompt: The kite is made of blue paper.
questions.explanation: B False，风筝红纸，尾条蓝色；A True混淆主体与尾部。

questions.prompt: The tail has five strips after Noah adds more.
questions.explanation: A True，两条加三条等于五；B False否定明确合计。

questions.prompt: The kite first falls on the grass.
questions.explanation: A True对应草地；B False否定落点。

questions.prompt: Noah holds the kite while his aunt picks up the string.
questions.explanation: B False，阿姨拿风筝，Noah捡线；A True对调人物。

questions.prompt: They try the kite again in the street.
questions.explanation: B False，公园且明确非街道；A True违背地点。

units.title: 早餐桌前的请求与问答

materials.title: Breakfast Answers 040N
materials.text: Choose the best reply to each question at breakfast.

questions.prompt: Would you like some milk?
questions.explanation: A礼貌接受饮品；B位置、C年龄不回应邀请。

questions.prompt: Where is the bread?
questions.explanation: C回答地点；A颜色、B频率不答where。

questions.prompt: Who wants the last egg?
questions.explanation: B表明要蛋的人；A温度、C数量不答who。

questions.prompt: Can you pass the butter?
questions.explanation: A同意并递物；B颜色、C时段不完成请求。

questions.prompt: How many cups are on the table?
questions.explanation: B数量三；A状态、C用途非how many。

units.title: 观鸟表上的记录规则

materials.title: Bird Watch Sheet 040O
materials.text: During bird watch, work in pairs. One pupil looks through binoculars while the other writes. Record the time, place and number of birds. If you cannot name a bird, draw its shape and write down its colours. Do not guess a name. After ten minutes, swap jobs. Stay on the path so you do not disturb nests.

questions.prompt: How should pupils work?
questions.explanation: B两人一组；A单独、C十人组均非安排。

questions.prompt: What should a pupil do with an unknown bird?
options: Leave the path to catch it.
Draw its shape and note colours.
questions.explanation: C形状与颜色帮助后续识别；A明确禁猜；B偏离路径且干扰鸟。

questions.prompt: When do partners swap jobs?
questions.explanation: A十分钟后；B每只后、C下周均错。

questions.prompt: Why must pupils stay on the path?
questions.explanation: B避免干扰巢；A铅笔、C放大器具无因果。

questions.prompt: Which set of facts must be recorded?
questions.explanation: A三项记录；B无关；C仅名字遗漏要求且可未知。

units.title: 烘焙义卖的盒子与零钱

materials.title: Bake Sale Sign 040P
materials.text: The bake sale opens at eleven. Small cakes cost one pound each. Bread rolls cost fifty pence each. Pupils may buy up to two cakes, but there is no limit on rolls. Buyers bring their own boxes; paper bags are available only for people without boxes. The money will buy books for the school reading corner.

questions.prompt: The sale starts at eleven.
questions.explanation: A True对应开始时间；B False否定原句。

questions.prompt: A bread roll costs one pound.
questions.explanation: B False，面包卷五十便士，一镑是小蛋糕；A True串价格。

questions.prompt: A pupil may buy three cakes.
questions.explanation: B False，最多两个；A True超限。

questions.prompt: Paper bags are for buyers who have no boxes.
questions.explanation: A True对应only条件；B False否定提供对象。

questions.prompt: The money is for new sports balls.
questions.explanation: B False，买阅读角书籍；A True把资金用途换成球。

units.title: 两块天气记录板的差异

materials.title: Weather Board 040Q
materials.text: Two classes measured rainfall in the school garden. Class A checked its jar every day at nine and emptied it afterwards. Class B checked only on Friday and then emptied its jar. At the end of a wet week, Class A had five small readings; Class B had one larger reading. Some pupils thought Class B had found much more rain. Their teacher explained that the readings covered different lengths of time. To compare the total for the same week, Class A needed to add its daily readings together.

questions.prompt: How often did Class A empty its jar?
questions.explanation: C每天读数后倒空；A每月、B仅周五是错频率。

questions.prompt: Why was Class B’s single reading larger?
options: Its pupils wrote larger numbers on purpose.
It never rained near Class A.
questions.explanation: A累积多天解释单次大；B故意写大、C一处没雨与材料不符。

questions.prompt: What should Class A do for a weekly comparison?
questions.explanation: B日读数相加得周量；A只取一天、C扔记录不能同周比较。

questions.prompt: What was the pupils’ initial mistake?
options: They compared readings that covered different times.
questions.explanation: B比较时间跨度不同；A地点、C规范倒水不是所述误区。

questions.prompt: What is necessary for a fair total-rain comparison here?
questions.explanation: A同时间段才能比总降雨；B字色、C人数无关读数覆盖。

units.title: 学生导览的报名与训练

materials.title: Pupil Guide Cards 040R
materials.text: Student guides are needed for the school open day. Applicants must attend one training session on either Monday or Wednesday. Both sessions teach the same route. Guides work in pairs and lead groups of up to eight visitors. A teacher stays at the main desk to answer questions that guides cannot answer. Guides should say they will check instead of guessing.

questions.prompt: Applicants must attend both training sessions.
questions.explanation: B False，either选择一次；A True把二选一变两次都要。

questions.prompt: The two sessions teach the same route.
questions.explanation: A True对应same route；B False否定内容一致。

questions.prompt: Each guide works alone.
questions.explanation: B False，in pairs；A True与搭档制冲突。

questions.prompt: A visitor group may have eight people.
questions.explanation: A True，up to eight包含八；B False否定边界允许。

questions.prompt: Guides should check an answer they do not know.
questions.explanation: A True对应check instead of guessing；B False否定应对方式。

units.title: 小剧场的字幕试演

materials.title: Theatre Letter 040S
materials.text:
Dear Hazel,
Our youth theatre tried written captions at yesterday’s rehearsal. We thought a screen behind the actors would be easy to read. In fact, some audience members kept moving their eyes between the actors and the screen and missed small gestures. We then placed two smaller screens closer to the sides of the stage. The same words appeared on both, so viewers could choose the nearer one. This helped, but the captions sometimes changed too late. We will adjust their timing before inviting the public. The actors will keep speaking; the captions will support the performance rather than replace it.
Love,
Max

questions.prompt: The first caption screen was behind the actors.
questions.explanation: A True位置明确；B False否定初始摆位。

questions.prompt: Every viewer found the first arrangement easy to follow.
questions.explanation: B False，有人移视线漏手势；A True将预想效果当实际普遍效果。

questions.prompt: The two smaller screens showed different words.
questions.explanation: B False，same words；A True颠倒屏幕内容。

questions.prompt: Caption timing still needed improvement.
questions.explanation: A True字幕有时换晚需调整；B False否定未解决问题。

questions.prompt: The actors will stop speaking when captions are used.
questions.explanation: B False，keep speaking；A True把辅助字幕当替代表演。

units.title: 社区访谈里的拒答和引用

materials.title: Neighbour Interview 040T
materials.text: A class is collecting short memories for a neighbourhood display. People may decline any question. The pupils will ask permission before showing a person’s name or exact words. Choose the appropriate reply.

questions.prompt: A neighbour does not want to answer one question. Say: ____
options: You must answer to help us.
That is fine; we can skip it.
questions.explanation: B尊重可跳题；A强迫、C编造违反访谈规则。

questions.prompt: You want to quote her exact words. Ask: ____
options: May we put these words in the display?
Can we change your memory without telling you?
Why is the display board tall?
questions.explanation: A引用前征求许可；B擅改、C板高均不请求引用授权。

questions.prompt: She asks to see the quotation first. Say: ____
options: Of course. Here is the sentence we plan to use.
questions.explanation: C提供拟用句供审阅；A拒绝、B藏起不回应检查。

questions.prompt: You are unsure whether a date is correct. Say: ____
options: Could we check that date together?
We must choose the oldest date.
questions.explanation: A共同核对；B选最旧、C绝对不重要不查事实。

questions.prompt: She agrees to anonymous use only. Say: ____
options: We will print your full name.
We will use the agreed words without your name.
We will ask visitors to guess your name.
questions.explanation: B按匿名许可使用；A全名、C引导猜名破坏边界。
